description: The Fuss-Catalan number C(p*n+1, n) / (p*n+1). FC(2,n) is the Catalan number, so FC(2,5) is 42. p runs from 1 to 8 and n from 0 to 30. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Returns JSON with: p, n, value. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Base or Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/fuss-catalan
